services.name: Zoo Layout
services.desc: Take a walk on the wild side and enjoy an adventure to remember and cherish. Our Animal Encounters are private, behind-the-scenes experiences allowing guests to get up close and personal with amazing animals with big personalities. Our expert animal keepers will share fascinating information about the animals and what it takes to care for them. Penguins from Africa? Birds that can’t fly? Join us on this delightful encounter to learn all about some of our most charming, feathered friends. Discover the amazing adaptations that help these magnificent birds thrive while you sit among the colony of the Caldwell penguins. services.name: Summer Camp
services.desc: Summer is a magical time. Free days offer endless opportunities for fun and adventure. Why lie around staring at a screen or wishing you had more to do? The most memorable summer days are filled with excitement and action. Summer Camps at the Caldwell Zoo engage kids’ minds and bodies through programs that will nurture their love of nature. Each of our weekly camps is custom-built around a special theme, with hands-on activities showing kids just how awesome the animal kingdom really is. services.name: Saving Wildlife
services.desc: Conservation is a driving force behind the Association of Zoos and Aquariums (AZA). Every member of the AZA must participate in conservation efforts worldwide while achieving high standards of excellence in animal care at home. The Caldwell Zoo has been an accredited member of the AZA for over 35 years. Assisting wildlife is a cornerstone of our mission. Many of the animals that live on our campus are increasingly at risk in the wild. That’s why we dedicate considerable resources and partner with other top facilities to help threatened and endangered animals.
